div.div:
Legend — lifecycle of one file name as seen by SyncEngine (computeSyncPlan, UC14)
States: purple = synchronization (one-sided / modified), yellow = transfer in progress, green = synchronized, red = version conflict (UC14b, newest version wins)
Transition label: event [guard] / action. ◇ = choice pseudo-state, ● = initial, ◉ = final (Deleted: file removed on both sides)
